name: SDN Host File Node
description: Host filesystem connector (typed contracts 1.0). Method "read_file": "request" $FIL (SDS standard FIL) naming PATH -> filesystem.readFile (+ filesystem.stat) -> "file" $FIL {PATH, NAME, KIND File, SIZE, CONTENT verbatim, MODIFIED_AT_MS when the host reports it}. Method "write_file": "file" $FIL {PATH, CONTENT, APPEND} -> filesystem.writeFile (or filesystem.appendFile when APPEND) -> "result" $FIL {PATH, NAME, KIND File, SIZE bytes written, APPEND, WRITTEN_AT_MS from clock.now (0 when the clock is not granted)}, no CONTENT. All hostcalls are SDS $PIV invocations (raw "path" / "data" frames); no JSON. HOST SUPPORT: the SDK NodeHost serves filesystem.* against a sandboxed root; the SDK BrowserHost only with a filesystem adapter (absent adapter, calls fail closed). The Go server host (sdn-server modulert) has no filesystem handler today, so server-side invokes fail closed with the host's error until one lands.

externalInterfaces.description: Host sandboxed filesystem hostcalls as SDS $PIV invocations (raw "path" / "data"; filesystem.stat -> FsStat) and clock.now for write times. SDK NodeHost (sandbox root) and SDK BrowserHost (filesystem adapter required); Go server host: not yet implemented.

acceptedTypeSets.description: $FIL naming PATH (relative to the host's sandbox root); other fields are not read.
$FIL: PATH (as requested), NAME (last element), KIND File, SIZE, CONTENT (filesystem.readFile verbatim), MODIFIED_AT_MS (filesystem.stat; 0 when unavailable).

methods.description: Reads PATH through filesystem.readFile and emits the file as one $FIL with CONTENT. BATCHING: every input port here is single-stream BY CONTRACT and that is ENFORCED IN CODE: the compiled flow runtime drains a node's whole queue port-blind, so a surplus is refused with error code "batched-input-frames", naming the port and the count (graph task modules-guest-nodes-drop-batched-frames).

acceptedTypeSets.description: $FIL: PATH (relative to the host's sandbox root), CONTENT (written verbatim; empty writes an empty file), APPEND (true appends to the existing file).
$FIL: PATH, NAME, KIND File, SIZE (bytes written), APPEND, WRITTEN_AT_MS (clock.now; 0 when unavailable); no CONTENT.

methods.description: Writes (or appends) CONTENT to PATH through filesystem.writeFile / filesystem.appendFile and emits what was written as one $FIL without content. BATCHING: every input port here is single-stream BY CONTRACT and that is ENFORCED IN CODE: the compiled flow runtime drains a node's whole queue port-blind, so a surplus is refused with error code "batched-input-frames", naming the port and the count (graph task modules-guest-nodes-drop-batched-frames).
